caption: The drawing features a rectangular section centered on a beige background, with the main composition set against a light blue field. Within the blue area, there are two repeating groups. Each group contains a depiction of a tree with green foliage and brown trunk, where the trunk is shaped like a person with a face, arms, and legs, interacting with a small child dressed in pink and brown. The child in each vignette is reaching up towards the tree-person. In addition to these scenes, there are two large pink roses with green leaves, and multiple clusters of small yellow floral motifs, arranged symmetrically. The elements are distributed so that the two tree-person and child scenes are on the upper right and lower left, while the roses are on the upper left and lower right, with the smaller motifs interspersed between. The word "ZIMET" appears printed at the bottom right corner of the beige background.
title: Wall Paper ("The Cherry Boy")
